name: High job demands
description: Excessive workload, tight deadlines, intense effort required.

name: Low job demands
description: Insufficient work, monotonous tasks, underuse of skills.

name: Job control
description: Level of autonomy and influence workers have over their work.

name: Support
description: Adequacy of help from supervisors, colleagues, and company resources.

name: Role clarity
description: Clear understanding of responsibilities and expectations.

name: Change management
description: How workplace changes are managed and communicated.

name: Fairness
description: Fairness in policies, procedures, and treatment.

name: Traumatic events
description: Exposure to distressing incidents or materials.

name: Remote/isolated work
description: Working alone or in locations with limited access to help.

name: Physical environment
description: Quality and safety of working conditions.

name: Violence and aggression
description: Physical or verbal threats and attacks.

name: Workplace relationships
description: Quality of interpersonal interactions and conflict.
